programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'lion', and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see what lions look like and what they do. There's a big lion, a baby lion, a roaring lion and a handsome lion. There's a lion on a cupcake, a lion on a doorknocker and a lion playing hide-and-seek! A sleeping lion, a leaping lion and a lion that Dee loves. The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today's word.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie and Triggs are bored. It's been raining for what seems like forever and they really want to play outside! They have exhausted the ideas for playing indoors. Now that it is completely quiet in the house, they discover some sounds they have never noticed before. The duo shrink down and explore a treasure trove of new sounds.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Cherry wants to photograph a rare and shy butterfly. The Piggy Builders are eager to help, but they get so competitive that they scare it away. Cherry is heartbroken. To fix their mistake, they will have to work together.

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: The Twirlywoos watch two men carry some furniture down the stairs in a block of flats. When the men take a break, the Twirlywoos see if they can help by carrying some things down. First they take a painting down and then a chest of drawers, but when they try to take a wardrobe down it topples right down the stairs!

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin and his friends visit a living museum to experience life in the olden days. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble has overslept because his alarm clock is broken – but he has a plan!

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: The Teletubbies count to four - four Teletubbies, four flowers, four pieces of tubby toast. In Tummy Tales, two sisters help their dad put a number four on the front door of their house.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Giovanna and Baby Bear welcome babies Marta, Billie, Hud, Elijah, Thomas, Finley and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Parents, carers and their babies at home are invited to join in with all the fun activities too! Inside Giovanna’s bag is a rubber duck, and all the parents and babies have different bath toys in their bags which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding a baby appropriate rubber duck or bath toy inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The nursery rhyme Three Little Ducks features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Plus, the Together Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: I Spy, You Spy
programme.desc: Elsee visits a building site with her new friend Dreya to play a game of I-spy.

programme.title: What’s in Your Plant Pot?
programme.desc: Birdwatcher George introduces the Fact Pack to moss. They discover how moss grows without flowers or seeds, how it spreads using spores, and why moss is important for birds and nature.

programme.title: Let's Go for a Walk
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers walk to a great place to fly their paper planes. On the way they discover a secret squirrel den, sit on a dragonfly, race like boats and even walk like dinosaurs!

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Kiri and Lou discover some ancient bones.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey, Bingo and Mum get into a debate with Dad about the definition of teasing. Dad argues that he was only playing as they recall all the times when he's been a big teaser.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: When a dancing bug lands on Duggee's head, he can't stop bopping. The Squirrels take a close look and see that it's a tiny hillbilly bug with a fiddle. And what's more, he's got a whole band with him - the Hillbilly Bug Band.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: Zola-Rose discovers lots of interesting facts about super-slow snails! Rory and his son Sandy search for snails in the garden and put on a very exciting snail race, while Ferne meets some very rare snails and holds a giant African land snail at the zoo. Also, we find out why snails are so important to the environment. They play an important part in a giant food web.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: When Henry and his family go on a trip to a nearby pond, it’s fishing nets at the ready as they try their hand at a spot of shrimping! It’s not easy as the tiny shrimp are good at hiding. Luckily, Henry comes up with a plan – but will it work? And will they catch any shrimp? Later, it’s Henry who is good at hiding in a family game of hide-and-seek. But will his clever hiding place be discovered?

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Jen and Small are finding it hard to hear each other today. Olive the opera singer comes to visit, Small finds out how lemons grow, and they make musical muffins for their special tuneful guest.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Dan and Jamie head for the hills to earn their compass badge searching for some missing ramblers and their teachers.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: Solomon and his friends are practising letters with Miss Gerrard. Outside, the children are going to the climbing wall area, and Mrs Collins has a challenge for them. Later, Solomon and Lusungu get arty and make their very own tie-dye t-shirts to wear, with help from Mrs Farrell.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Mrs Hobbs supervises Waffle at the Brooklyn-Bell house. Waffle wants to join Evie at school and tries to escape. Later, the family look at photos and Evie asks about her birth dad.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Phoenix eagerly joins puffin practice with Oona, Isabelle and Baba, who are digging, walking and fishing! Phoenix is very excited to learn, but he doubts himself when he can’t do everything the puffins can. But when the seagulls cause trouble, Phoenix's own talents save the day!

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: When Sonny finds an old line-dancing record, Yukee thinks it would be a mighty swell idea if the gang had a line dance in the Sunhouse. But remembering the moves proves a problem for the gang, can Yukee find a way to help them?

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie and Triggs are putting on a stage show for Mum - they've created characters, a story, costumes and songs. The only problem is, Dad keeps making noise with his DIY! Does he not realise they're trying to put on an epic show?

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Brian sets up a treasure hunt for the Piggies and is excited to challenge them with riddles tailored to their building skills! But Wilf is determined to find the treasure first so that he can keep it for himself. He might just ruin this unforgettable day...

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Learn how much fun counting can be with the Numberblocks - a fun-loving group of numbers who work together to solve problems big and small.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: M can't resist munching everything in sight until a giant toad appears. Suddenly he is not the biggest eater around! This episode introduces the '-oa-' digraph and the words toad, coat, coal, goal, goat, moat, loaf and toast.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Educational series using Makaton sign language. Today, Justin and his friend are animal keepers at an animal park. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble is caring for an animal too.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Laa-Laa and Po have fun, first rolling a ball down a hill and then rolling each other! The Teletubbies enjoy watching children have fun rolling slowly down slopes too.

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: Kipekee the baby elephant and her friends find ways to cool down in the hot sun. Hamza sees vultures in the wild, and some of the animals get weighed at the orphanage.

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: Molly examines her shelf of special things at the back of Mack’s stall. She chooses the friendship necklace and remembers the day she got it. It’s Molly’s first day running the toy stall with Mack, but she is taken aback when Suki reveals that it is her last day at the Big Hub. Meanwhile, a pregnant Alice meets the two newest stallholders, Kez and Ayesha, and gives them a few top tips for dealing with Big Hub manager, Moira. Molly decides that Suki should have a goodbye party and sets about organising it. She meets Kez and Ayesha, who are playing loud music as they set up their stall, and asks them to supply some music for the party. When Molly finally gets a chance to talk to Suki about leaving, Suki reveals she doesn’t want a fuss, as she’s just going to help out at the animal sanctuary more and will still be around. Molly starts to think a party might be a step too far and tries to undo her planning. Suki gives Molly a present and they both promise to stay friends forever. As Suki leaves, all the Hubbers give her a very special Big Hub goodbye.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, CBeebies' very own motorbike rider Grace shows off three amazing steam machines! Grace drives a paddle steamer around a river, shows off the super-fast Inspiration land speed car and then drives an old steam car!

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: It's Kindness Day, and the pups notice that Puggers is not being himself. The pups try various acts of kindness to cheer him up.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger and the Pea-Rexes accidentally wake up a Kiwimammuthus during a snowball fight.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: Kwazii and Periwinkle try to help a bird found in the Sonoran Desert.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: After Benjamin gets lost in the woods, Peter and Lily give him a map to help him find his way home. But when the map falls into Mr Tod's hands, the rabbits must work together to stop the fox from finding their home.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Join Duggee, a big, lovable dog, as he runs the Squirrel Club, where children can earn badges for learning new skills. Warm-hearted preschool series about trying new things.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: When a mysterious creature splashes around Sweetwood, Popcorn thinks it must be a monster.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato and Carrot are teaching a nervous Chilli how to drive the Tatocar. Suddenly, the car starts moving back and forth! Evil Pea is using a remote control to send the Tatocar speeding backwards to the other side of the supermarket. The Tato Team must make an epic journey back to the veggie aisle to stop Evil Pea from taking over. When they finally make it back, they dress an egg up as Supertato and put it in the car. Now, it is Captain Chilli’s turn to use the remote and distract Evil Pea so that Supertato can save the fruit and veggies.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Weasy keeps wrecking the Ducklings' playground with his remote-controlled car, so they use an invention from the Farm of the Future to create a barrier - but Weasy steals it to use for his own game!

programme.title: Do Not Watch This Show
programme.desc: After Wizz loses a bike, everything around him begins to disappear into thin air.

programme.desc: Mackenzie, Jack and Rusty are playing astronauts on a mission to Mars!

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Zog cures Fifi’s hiccups with a big dragon roar. But when patients are too scared to be treated by him, Zog must choose between being a scary dragon or a doctor.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island
programme.desc: Andy and Jen jump into the magic old museum clock and travel 68 million years back in time for prehistoric adventures on Dino Island. The duo search for a missing baby Pachycephalosaurus called Bumper, who has become separated from his family. Jen looks for him in some nearby caves, while Andy heads to the river.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Connie and Ruby move into Maple Close with their dog, Jelly. Mrs Hobbs can't help but express her disapproval. She hates dogs and now there'll be another one living in close proximity. Waffle is not allowed to go on a family camping trip but accidentally goes on a different adventure!

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi, Ruby and Finn play football against Khia’s team. Rafi is goalie, but she keeps missing shots and feels under pressure. She makes a wish for giant hands to save every ball. When the wish ends, Rafi worries she’ll lose, but Ruby and Finn remind her she’s already a great goalie. Believing in herself, Rafi makes a fingertip save on Khia’s penalty and wins the game fairly.

programme.desc: When JoJo runs out of storybooks to read at Gran Gran's house, she visits the library with Gran Gran and gets her very own card from Terrence the Librarian. JoJo learns all about the library and how it works, and discovers just how amazing it is; she is stuck for choice. JoJo feels very lucky to have a card that means she can borrow books to read over-and-over again.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Sarah is inspired by listening to a poetry record and decides to make up some poetry of her own.

programme.desc: Small and Major Clanger discover a bowl of glow honey that the glowbuzzers have left out in a crater. They take it inside to eat but find some very agitated glowbuzzers, who need them to put it back where they found it for a special visitor.

programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa want to spin without stopping but get dizzy and fall over. At Yummy Time, they eat from a spinning carousel that must stop so they can take their food. Gramma Leeba tells them that Planet BeddyByes is always spinning in space.

programme.desc: Things are becoming lost. The Pontipine children are nowhere to be found, and the Tombliboos' toothbrushes just won't stay put. Eventually the Tombliboos catch up with their toothbrushes and give their teeth a really good clean.

programme.desc: Bluey, Bingo and Mum get into a debate with Dad about the definition of teasing. Dad argues that he was only playing as they recall all the times when he's been a big teaser.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: When a dancing bug lands on Duggee's head, he can't stop bopping. The Squirrels take a close look and see that it's a tiny hillbilly bug with a fiddle. And what's more, he's got a whole band with him - the Hillbilly Bug Band.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: Zola-Rose discovers lots of interesting facts about super-slow snails! Rory and his son Sandy search for snails in the garden and put on a very exciting snail race, while Ferne meets some very rare snails and holds a giant African land snail at the zoo. Also, we find out why snails are so important to the environment. They play an important part in a giant food web.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: When Henry and his family go on a trip to a nearby pond, it’s fishing nets at the ready as they try their hand at a spot of shrimping! It’s not easy as the tiny shrimp are good at hiding. Luckily, Henry comes up with a plan – but will it work? And will they catch any shrimp? Later, it’s Henry who is good at hiding in a family game of hide-and-seek. But will his clever hiding place be discovered?

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Jen and Small are finding it hard to hear each other today. Olive the opera singer comes to visit, Small finds out how lemons grow, and they make musical muffins for their special tuneful guest.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Dan and Jamie head for the hills to earn their compass badge searching for some missing ramblers and their teachers.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: Solomon and his friends are practising letters with Miss Gerrard. Outside, the children are going to the climbing wall area, and Mrs Collins has a challenge for them. Later, Solomon and Lusungu get arty and make their very own tie-dye t-shirts to wear, with help from Mrs Farrell.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Mrs Hobbs supervises Waffle at the Brooklyn-Bell house. Waffle wants to join Evie at school and tries to escape. Later, the family look at photos and Evie asks about her birth dad.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Phoenix eagerly joins puffin practice with Oona, Isabelle and Baba, who are digging, walking and fishing! Phoenix is very excited to learn, but he doubts himself when he can’t do everything the puffins can. But when the seagulls cause trouble, Phoenix's own talents save the day!

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: When Sonny finds an old line-dancing record, Yukee thinks it would be a mighty swell idea if the gang had a line dance in the Sunhouse. But remembering the moves proves a problem for the gang, can Yukee find a way to help them?

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie and Triggs are putting on a stage show for Mum - they've created characters, a story, costumes and songs. The only problem is, Dad keeps making noise with his DIY! Does he not realise they're trying to put on an epic show?

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Brian sets up a treasure hunt for the Piggies and is excited to challenge them with riddles tailored to their building skills! But Wilf is determined to find the treasure first so that he can keep it for himself. He might just ruin this unforgettable day...

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Learn how much fun counting can be with the Numberblocks - a fun-loving group of numbers who work together to solve problems big and small.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: M can't resist munching everything in sight until a giant toad appears. Suddenly he is not the biggest eater around! This episode introduces the '-oa-' digraph and the words toad, coat, coal, goal, goat, moat, loaf and toast.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Educational series using Makaton sign language. Today, Justin and his friend are animal keepers at an animal park. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble is caring for an animal too.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Laa-Laa and Po have fun, first rolling a ball down a hill and then rolling each other! The Teletubbies enjoy watching children have fun rolling slowly down slopes too.

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: Kipekee the baby elephant and her friends find ways to cool down in the hot sun. Hamza sees vultures in the wild, and some of the animals get weighed at the orphanage.

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: Molly examines her shelf of special things at the back of Mack’s stall. She chooses the friendship necklace and remembers the day she got it. It’s Molly’s first day running the toy stall with Mack, but she is taken aback when Suki reveals that it is her last day at the Big Hub. Meanwhile, a pregnant Alice meets the two newest stallholders, Kez and Ayesha, and gives them a few top tips for dealing with Big Hub manager, Moira. Molly decides that Suki should have a goodbye party and sets about organising it. She meets Kez and Ayesha, who are playing loud music as they set up their stall, and asks them to supply some music for the party. When Molly finally gets a chance to talk to Suki about leaving, Suki reveals she doesn’t want a fuss, as she’s just going to help out at the animal sanctuary more and will still be around. Molly starts to think a party might be a step too far and tries to undo her planning. Suki gives Molly a present and they both promise to stay friends forever. As Suki leaves, all the Hubbers give her a very special Big Hub goodbye.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, CBeebies' very own motorbike rider Grace shows off three amazing steam machines! Grace drives a paddle steamer around a river, shows off the super-fast Inspiration land speed car and then drives an old steam car!

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: It's Kindness Day, and the pups notice that Puggers is not being himself. The pups try various acts of kindness to cheer him up.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger and the Pea-Rexes accidentally wake up a Kiwimammuthus during a snowball fight.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: Kwazii and Periwinkle try to help a bird found in the Sonoran Desert.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: After Benjamin gets lost in the woods, Peter and Lily give him a map to help him find his way home. But when the map falls into Mr Tod's hands, the rabbits must work together to stop the fox from finding their home.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Join Duggee, a big, lovable dog, as he runs the Squirrel Club, where children can earn badges for learning new skills. Warm-hearted preschool series about trying new things.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: When a mysterious creature splashes around Sweetwood, Popcorn thinks it must be a monster.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato and Carrot are teaching a nervous Chilli how to drive the Tatocar. Suddenly, the car starts moving back and forth! Evil Pea is using a remote control to send the Tatocar speeding backwards to the other side of the supermarket. The Tato Team must make an epic journey back to the veggie aisle to stop Evil Pea from taking over. When they finally make it back, they dress an egg up as Supertato and put it in the car. Now, it is Captain Chilli’s turn to use the remote and distract Evil Pea so that Supertato can save the fruit and veggies.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Weasy keeps wrecking the Ducklings' playground with his remote-controlled car, so they use an invention from the Farm of the Future to create a barrier - but Weasy steals it to use for his own game!

programme.title: Do Not Watch This Show
programme.desc: After Wizz loses a bike, everything around him begins to disappear into thin air.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Mackenzie, Jack and Rusty are playing astronauts on a mission to Mars!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo find ways to entertain themselves on a family road trip.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Zog cures Fifi’s hiccups with a big dragon roar. But when patients are too scared to be treated by him, Zog must choose between being a scary dragon or a doctor.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island
programme.desc: Andy and Jen jump into the magic old museum clock and travel 68 million years back in time for prehistoric adventures on Dino Island. The duo search for a missing baby Pachycephalosaurus called Bumper, who has become separated from his family. Jen looks for him in some nearby caves, while Andy heads to the river.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Connie and Ruby move into Maple Close with their dog, Jelly. Mrs Hobbs can't help but express her disapproval. She hates dogs and now there'll be another one living in close proximity. Waffle is not allowed to go on a family camping trip but accidentally goes on a different adventure!

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi, Ruby and Finn play football against Khia’s team. Rafi is goalie, but she keeps missing shots and feels under pressure. She makes a wish for giant hands to save every ball. When the wish ends, Rafi worries she’ll lose, but Ruby and Finn remind her she’s already a great goalie. Believing in herself, Rafi makes a fingertip save on Khia’s penalty and wins the game fairly.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: When JoJo runs out of storybooks to read at Gran Gran's house, she visits the library with Gran Gran and gets her very own card from Terrence the Librarian. JoJo learns all about the library and how it works, and discovers just how amazing it is; she is stuck for choice. JoJo feels very lucky to have a card that means she can borrow books to read over-and-over again.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Sarah is inspired by listening to a poetry record and decides to make up some poetry of her own.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: Small and Major Clanger discover a bowl of glow honey that the glowbuzzers have left out in a crater. They take it inside to eat but find some very agitated glowbuzzers, who need them to put it back where they found it for a special visitor.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa want to spin without stopping but get dizzy and fall over. At the Play Tree, they spin on a roundabout before playing with a spinning top, which spins for a long time until it wobbles and falls over. At Yummy Time, they eat from a spinning carousel that must stop so they can take their food. Gramma Leeba tells them that Planet BeddyByes is always spinning in space.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: Things are becoming lost. The Pontipine children are nowhere to be found, and the Tombliboos' toothbrushes just won't stay put. Eventually the Tombliboos catch up with their toothbrushes and give their teeth a really good clean.

programme.desc: Ke Huy Quan reads a warm and wise story about the mightiest, bitiest lion called Brian.

But Christine has more reason than many other foundlings to understand why a mother might give up a child.

programme.desc: Home improvement programme where contractor Brian McCourt and designer Sarah Keenleyside help to expand living spaces by tapping into people's backyards. programme.title: Dress To Impress
programme.desc: Law student and model Neeki is hoping to be impressed by the style choices of three single ladies - he will set two style challenges and have to decipher the clues behind the clothes because he won't see the girls that are choosing his outfits. Singletons Sophie, Shannon and Amelia are the girls competing for a date, but who will Dress to Impress?

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City
programme.desc: US reality series peeking inside the unconventional lives of six successful women living in or around Salt Lake City, Utah. The reunion continues with Mary sharing an emotional update about her son and how she feels about her church being in the spotlight. The women attempt to come to a resolution about what happened on the plane ride from Canouan. Heather draws a line in the sand with Meredith. Meredith provides some insight into the shocking root of her issues with Britani.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Orange County
programme.desc: Reality show following the lavish lifestyles of five 'housewives' and their families. The OC ladies come face-to-face for a dramatic 19th series reunion where Shannon confronts Tamra, Katie reflects on her early exit, Emily opens up on her son's diagnosis and Andy Cohen questions Tamra about her behaviour.

programme.title: The Only Way is Essex
programme.desc: After having it out with Amber, Harry feels that Brockett's meddling has made a mountain out of a molehill when it comes to his and Amy's supposed griping, but will he call her out for running her mouth, or will Brockett bare her grievances first? Elsewhere, Brockett speculates that her freshly reconciled friendship with Saff will be at risk if Saff can't hold her tongue on the topic of Amber - will they be able to work through their issues when they meet up, or will we witness a classic TOWIE blow-up? Although Junaid and Brockett are happy that the beef is over between them, there's one person who's not - Ella. After finally feeling content in a friendship group, worries start to creep in that she might be left behind by her besties - will Junaid stay loyal to Ella, will Brockett break him away from his newly-formed friendships, and will Ella's emotions come to the surface?

programme.title: Dawson's Creek
programme.desc: US drama series charting the ups and downs of adolescence as experienced by a group of precocious teenagers. Rumours of Pacey's affair with Tamara spread around the school as Bessie gives birth in Dawson's living room with the help of Jen's grandmother, who is forced to act as an impromptu midwife.

programme.title: Charmed
programme.desc: Classic US supernatural drama about three sisters who fight the forces of evil using their combined power of witchcraft known as the Power of Three. Piper caters a wedding with Phoebe's help but discovers that Elliot the groom is under a spell cast by his bride Jade - who is actually a Hecate demon who must mate to continue the line of her race - and is forced to marry her instead of his true love Allison.

programme.title: Deal or No Deal
programme.desc: Stephen Mulhern hosts as Jay opens the iconic red boxes - he may be tempted to take an offer from the Banker or hold out in the hope that he has 100,000 pounds inside his box.

programme.title: Supermarket Sweep
programme.desc: Rylan Clark-Neal hosts the iconic game show as three pairs of shoppers go wild in the aisles and compete in the ultimate supermarket challenge to win a 3,000-pound prize - along with the classic Supermarket Sweep quizzes, trolley dashes and pastel jumpers, the revamped show features exciting new games, challenges and some famous faces.

programme.title: The Floor US
programme.desc: Rob Lowe hosts the fast-paced game show. With 250,000 dollars on the line, the final 16 players face the toughest categories yet for a life-changing victory.

programme.title: The Only Way is Essex
programme.desc: It's Amber's birthday, and Dan has arranged for a surprise getaway with her nearest and dearest - including Amber's pals Mia and Hannah - when Mia reveals that Hannah has a crush on Gatsby. Will sparks fly between the pair? Elsewhere, Dani who is fuming at an Insta video in which Courtney, Chloe M and Gatsby blatantly dig her out - Dani is determined to find out why the girl band have such an issue with her and assumes that Gatsby has been blaming her for his feud with them. Despite the positive vibes at the Be Well Not Jel festival, Dani and Junaid go head to head with Courtney and Chloe M - will Dani get the answers she is looking for, or will things become even more heated and awkward than they were before? Things between Ella and Pete, meanwhile, seem to be progressing well, especially as Pete has found a real connection... with Ella's stepdad Mark - Jordan, on the other hand, is having a heart-to-heart with his mum about her recent cancer diagnosis.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City
programme.desc: US reality series peeking inside the unconventional lives of six successful women living in or around Salt Lake City, Utah. The reunion concludes with an emotional update from Bronwyn on her relationship with her mother and marriage to Todd. Lisa and Whitney are brought to tears over their own marriages. Bronwyn confronts Meredith about their off-camera conversation in Greece. After a tumultuous season, the women try to find ways to move forward.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Orange County
programme.desc: Reality show following the lavish lifestyles of five 'housewives' and their families. The 19th series reunion continues with the ladies questioning Tamra's intentions around sharing Jenn's old photo, Gina addressing comments about Heather's career, Jenn getting a phone call from Ryan revealing shocking information about Katie, and Matt Ginella joining the group in an explosive game of He Said, She Said.

programme.title: Celebrity Catchphrase
programme.desc: Stephen Mulhern hosts a celebrity special of the classic game show with Jane Danson, Eddie Kadi, and Tom Rosenthal all trying to 'say what they see' as they guess well-known phrases for the chance to win a 50,000-pound jackpot for their chosen charity.

programme.title: The Floor US
programme.desc: Rob Lowe hosts the American version of the game show. The final players compete for a life-changing victory and the winner is crowned.

programme.title: The 1% Club
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered how clever you are? This is your chance to find out as comedy legend Lee Mack presents the ultimate leveller of a quiz show - it doesn't matter if you're not usually good at quizzes because the questions have nothing to do with remembering facts and are all about logic and common sense. This is the quiz that the whole family can play together - 100 contestants begin every show and try to make it to the end to answer a question that only one per cent of the country can get right and win up to 100,000 pounds.

programme.title: The Only Way is Essex
programme.desc: Excitement builds as the Albania trip approaches, but fractured friendships threaten to overshadow the holiday. Dani and Ella's once-close bond has turned frosty but could time away help Harry and Elma repair their relationship? Elsewhere, Dani and Jonnie's rocky romance leaves the group wondering if Albania will make or break them. Diags creates a group chat to unite everyone, but it only fuels more tension resulting in one member of the group deciding not to go. As Sophie and Jordan await Baby Brook's arrival, they enjoy precious time together before the group gathers to wish them luck. By the time everyone returns from Albania, Baby Brook will have arrived! Meanwhile, Junaid enlists the help of Jodie and Ella to search for the perfect engagement ring for Joe. Later, Junaid confronts Lauren about the distance in their friendship. Will these two be able to rebuild their friendship and how will Lauren react to Junaid's big news?

programme.title: Family Guy
programme.desc: Subversive animated comedy about the trials and tribulations of American family life. Peter and the guys interview potential friends to fill the vacancy left by Cleveland, while Brian discovers that Quagmire hates him.
